title: Language Modeling with Hyperspherical Flows
abstract: arXiv:2605.11125v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models progressed rapidly as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, motivated by their parallel generation abilities. However, for tractability, discrete diffusion models sample from a factorized distribution, which is less expressive than AR. Recent Flow Language Models (FLMs) apply continuous flows to language, transporting noise to data with a deterministic ODE that avoids factorized sampling. FLMs operate on one-hot vectors whose dimension scales with the vocabulary size, making FLMs costly to train. Moreover, since all distinct one-hot embeddings are equidistant in $\ell_2$, adding Gaussian noise does not have a clear semantic interpretation (unlike images, where Gaussian noise progressively degrades structure). translated_title: 基于超球面流的语言建模
translated_abstract: 离散扩散语言模型凭借其并行生成能力，作为自回归（AR）模型的替代方案而迅速发展。然而，出于可处理性的考虑，离散扩散模型从因子化分布中采样，其表达能力不如自回归模型。近期的流语言模型（FLMs）将连续流应用于语言，通过确定性常微分方程（ODE）将噪声传输为数据，从而避免了因子化采样。但FLM在one-hot向量上运行，其维度随词表大小而扩展，导致FLM的训练成本高昂。此外，由于所有不同的one-hot嵌入在ℓ₂距离下彼此等距，添加高斯噪声缺乏清晰的语义解释（这与图像不同，图像中高斯噪声会逐渐破坏结构）。我们提出了𝕊-FLM，一种运行在超球面上的潜在流语言模型。𝕊-FLM通过在𝕊^{d-1}中沿着用交……（交叉熵等）学习到的速度场旋转向量来生成序列。
tldr: 提出𝕊-FLM，一种在超球面上通过旋转向量生成序列的潜在流语言模型，避免了基于one-hot向量的高维运算带来的高昂训练成本，并赋予噪声注入更清晰的语义解释。
en_tdlr: We introduce 𝕊-FLM, a latent flow language model that generates sequences by rotating vectors on a hypersphere, avoiding the costly high-dimensional one-hot operations of prior flow language models while providing a clearer semantic interpretation of noise injection.
